name: German Passport ICAO Doc 9303 Check Digit
description: Validates German passport numbers using the ICAO Doc 9303 check digit algorithm. Letters are mapped A=10..Z=35; digits keep face value. Weights [7,3,1] repeat across the first 8 characters. The sum mod 10 must equal the 9th character (digit). Also rejects characters outside the ICAO-restricted charset (excludes A,B,D,E,I,O,Q,S,U from positions 1-8).
